Inspection is finished; here is the final verdict, based only on the source and images I read.

## Source verdict: ACCEPT (all seven findings addressed)

| # | Finding | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | System mode resolved by CSS only | The `prefers-color-scheme` block is in `tokens.css:97`; there is no script or `matchMedia` call. |
| 2 | `color-scheme` set for every state | Light, dark and `light dark` are set in `tokens.css:57-58,95,134`. |
| 3 | Provider starts from the validated server value | `layout.tsx:25-28` and `theme.ts:3`. The provider never reads the cookie during render. The blocked-storage message does not claim the choice was saved (`theme-preference.tsx:26`). |
| 4 | Brand aliases re-declared at tenant scope | `workspace.css:10-15`: soft, border, brand-text and on-brand (`#fff`). Your correction is noted: the legacy soft/border re-declaration already existed. |
| 5 | Print restores light tokens | `tokens.css:139` uses `:root, :root[data-theme]`. It has equal specificity to the theme rules and comes later, so it wins. |
| 6 | Dark shadows | Inset highlight is 7% in dark mode. |
| 7 | Selector buttons are safe | `type="button"` with `aria-pressed`, no `name`, outside every form (`context-navigation-client.tsx:119,160`). Selecting a mode does not close the dialog. |

## Scoped visual verdict: CHANGES REQUIRED

**Images I actually inspected (all seven requested):**
- `theme-reference-light-desktop.jpg`
- `theme-reference-dark-desktop.jpg`
- `theme-reference-dark-mobile.jpg`
- `theme-light-desktop.jpg`
- `theme-dark-desktop.jpg`
- `theme-dark-mobile-menu.jpg`
- `theme-dark-mobile-form.jpg`

None are missing.

**Introduced blocker:** in `theme-light-desktop.jpg`, the selected «فاتح» label in the sidebar is nearly invisible: pale text on the pale `--color-brand-soft` background.
- Likely cause: an existing sidebar-footer button colour rule wins over `.theme-preference-options button { color }`.
- Fix: give the selected state an explicit readable foreground at sufficient specificity, for example `color: var(--color-text)`. Then measure its contrast in light, dark and system.
- The 4-brand × light/dark samples you listed check button and link colours, not this control state. This is a real failed state the user sees after choosing light.

**Matches, with accepted deviations:**
- Dark surfaces, card and border hierarchy, muted text, and the danger and secondary actions match the reference closely.
- Tenant teal keeps white text instead of the reference's dark-on-light-teal. This is accepted because the tenant brand contract wins.
- Sidebar instead of the reference's top bar is the existing navigation and is accepted.
- The 390px form shows no overflow.
- Text is retained, and the submit count stays at 0.

**Should verify (not a blocker from these images alone):**
- The mobile header menu button in `theme-dark-mobile-form.jpg` is faint. Measure its boundary contrast against the 3:1 non-text minimum.
- Unselected options in the mobile dialog show no control boundary.
- The fixture's error and success messages share the same surface in both themes. I can't tell from the inspected source whether this was introduced.
- The Next dev indicator covers «المزيد»; this is a capture artifact only.

## Remaining limitations

- This acceptance covers only the fixture's theme sample.
- Not accepted:
  - full R1 or R0–R8
  - all routes and feature pages (tables, leave, HR settings, payroll reports)
  - real Auth, provider or tenant RPC behaviour
  - gradient-button contrast
  - any speed claims
- Earlier financial, SQL and Auth suites stay reused and are not re-run or closed by this review.
- After the blocker fix, re-capture one light-desktop sidebar state.

## Final scoped visual verdict: MATCH WITH ACCEPTED DEVIATIONS

The previous blocker is fixed in the rendered images, and I found no new blockers. The source ACCEPT from the earlier review still stands.

**Images inspected in this delta (only these three):**
- **`theme-final-light-desktop.jpg`:** the selected «فاتح» label is now dark and readable on the soft brand background, with a teal outline. «داكن» and «حسب الجهاز» still read clearly. The rest of the page matches the earlier light capture. A still image can't show hover, so the hover state is not visually confirmed here.
- **`theme-final-dark-mobile-menu.jpg`:**
  - All three options now have a visible control border.
  - The selected «داكن» has a stronger border and outline.
  - Labels are light primary text, and the targets look about 44px tall.
  - The legend and Arabic right-to-left order are correct, nothing overflows at 390px, and the dialog stays open.
- **`theme-final-dark-mobile-form.jpg`:**
  - The menu button (☰) now has a light glyph and a clear border, so it's identifiable.
  - The form, actions, dark surfaces and 390px width are unchanged from the earlier capture.

**Accepted deviations (unchanged):** Cairo font, radius 8, control sizes, the existing sidebar/dialog navigation, white text on the actual tenant brand, and the stronger control borders for accessibility.

**Notes (not blockers):**
- The fixture field text differs from the earlier captures («بيانات مصطنعة»). That's fixture content, not a theme change. Text retention and zero form submits rely on the earlier evidence, which these images don't re-prove.
- Error and success messages share the fixture's generic message style. They aren't real feature feedback.
- The Next dev indicator covering «المزيد» is a capture artifact.
- The build was not re-run for this CSS-only fix; only the PostCSS parse passed. Run the production build once before merge.

**Remaining limitations:**
- This verdict covers only the theme fixture sample.
- Still open: full R1 and R0–R8, all routes and feature pages (tables, leave, HR settings, payroll reports), real Auth/provider/tenant behaviour, gradient-button contrast, PWA, Today, and D16.
- I make no speed or full-coverage claims.
- The financial, SQL and Auth suites are reused, not re-run or closed by this review.
